name: Chive noodle soup
summary: Tuy Hòa’s own noodle soup: soft strands that do not break, sea-fish cake, and a thick cover of chives. The smell of the chives is the draw, and the cake comes up in the same spoon.
origin: Tuy Hoa. The bowl is sold all day around chợ Tuy Hòa.
texture: The strands are soft without turning mushy and hold together in the pot. Phú Yên tourism’s food roundup makes them from bột lọc or bột gạo, while its bánh canh article says bột gạo.
taste: The fish cake is cá mối, cá cờ, or cá nhồng, pounded, shaped thick, steamed, then fried. Chives and cake go into every spoonful.
howToEat: Eat it hot, chives and chả cá together. It is sold all day, and a hot bowl suits a cold morning.
where: Chợ Tuy Hòa, on the Trần Hưng Đạo side of the market, and the corner of Ngô Quyền and Trần Hưng Đạo.
seoTitle: Banh canh he in Tuy Hoa — chives and fish cake
seoDescription: Banh canh he at Cho Tuy Hoa: soft strands, sea-fish cake, and a thick cover of chives, sold all day.
